title: Per-route model parameters, each with its reason and an evidence-based default
goal: Each role route carries only the parameters its engine accepts, and every parameter has a recorded reason and a default from Gauntlet evidence
acceptance: Cloud Claude models: effort level low, medium, high, xhigh or max (defaults: Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5.5 medium, Sonnet 5.5 high); temperature and top_p are not accepted by current Claude models, so config validation refuses them for a cloud route and the picker never shows them (test first)
Local Ollama models: thinking on or off, reply cap (num_predict), context size (num_ctx), temperature where the model honours it; unset means the engine default

A table in docs (the record and docs/agents/areas.md) states for each parameter why it exists: effort trades answer depth for cost and latency; thinking and reply cap decide whether a long answer is cut off (the 26b cad-3d cases); context size bounds memory use and what fits in a prompt; temperature only where it changes the result
Defaults come from the Gauntlet nights, not from guesses: F-126-T06 (gemma4:26b without thinking and with a larger cap) and F-126-T07 (12b); a default changes only with a new report cited
Parameters appear in the models report and the settings picker beside their route, in plain and Eva wording
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
